meta.title: Add comprehensive FrankenPHP support for phpMyFAQ
meta.body_summary: Add Docker-based FrankenPHP support for phpMyFAQ with high-performance worker mode, Caddyfile, documentation, and CHANGELOG entry.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added FrankenPHP Docker config; merged after adding missing CHANGELOG note as requested by maintainer.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 626 changed lines (mostly additions), this is a small-to-medium configuration and documentation PR by absolute volume. It fits a modular runtime addition that was merged quickly after a single minor request for a changelog entry.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer thorsten requested a note in CHANGELOG.md about the experimental FrankenPHP support; Copilot added the entry before merge.
review_details.performance_claim: FrankenPHP worker mode improves performance over traditional Apache/PHP-FPM setups by keeping PHP code in memory between requests.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A well-scoped infrastructure config PR; the only friction was a missing CHANGELOG entry, a project-specific convention that the agent successfully addressed after maintainer feedback.

detection_detail.code_reading: thorsten reviewed the PR content and requested a CHANGELOG addition via a PR comment.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiler evidence for the performance claim; testing results only confirm container startup and page loads.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: The missing CHANGELOG entry was added by Copilot in a follow-up commit before merge.

core_change_summary.description: Add Docker configuration for FrankenPHP runtime (Caddyfile, Dockerfile, entrypoint, worker scripts), update docker-compose, add documentation (installation, README), and add CHANGELOG entry.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Several .gitkeep and config files show zero-change modifications or empty commits, likely side effects of the work environment.
